profile.workload: order_id mod active Cells; POST inserts then receipt-bound SELECT; GET owner-ordered SELECT; closed loop

verification: Unchanged strict 18-point raw audit: receipt scope and gap-free per-Cell sequences, exact raw quantiles/TPS/response bytes, ownership refusal, exact live/cold replay, typed conflicts, drained idle Cells, fresh SQLite recovery, increased fencing epochs and next recovered writes. Fixed source/observer and resource-budget audit also passes.

provenance.note: Strict raw receipt/recovery audit must also pass via unchanged analyze-steady-writes.py.

limitations: Three paired repeats, not a statistical confidence interval.
Closed-loop small-row HTTP workload with one persistent connection per client.
Response throughput is JSON response-body bytes, not database or network-wire throughput.
Publication phase metrics include warmup; worker and queue metrics also include exact replay verification.
Compaction is a subset of preparation; do not add their timings.
Single host with a shared RustFS provider; no horizontal-scaling proof.
The third 16-Cell pair loses 4.1% TPS and increases p50 by 8.0%, despite lower p95/p99. The third 1-Cell pair increases p50 by 2.5%. All pairs, including regressions, are retained.
